persistence.measurement_time: collected_at preserves envelope.observed_at when supplied; ingestion does not refresh it
persistence.storage_policy: Private owned directory; SQLite, WAL and SHM mode 0600; binding key private and outside SQLite; immutable records; successful compatible observations indexed for reuse

compatibility_boundaries: Default authored EAL evaluation and opt-in ASPIC compilation remain separate operations.
CLI --methods package.module:function is replaced by a typed Rust registry and a versioned subprocess extension contract in the runtime stage.
Integers retain arbitrary precision; booleans remain distinct from numbers; scalar arithmetic and JSON identities require explicit differential checks.
Schema snapshots describe supplied structures. They do not establish graph well-formedness or authenticate provenance.
All MCP, runtime, solver, formatter and CLI operations in this file remain pending implementation in this first parser PR.
